Container.Name: Cleanarr
Container.Overview: Smart media library cleanup and storage optimization for the *Arr ecosystem. Cleanarr connects to Sonarr and Radarr, reads watch history from Plex and requests from Seerr (Overseerr/Jellyseerr), evaluates your rules against your library, and removes, unmonitors, or deletes the files of items that match. Safe by default: dry-run, approval queue, live revalidation before every write, fail-closed rules and a full audit trail.
Container.Requires: Sonarr and/or Radarr. Plex and Seerr are optional.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Cleanarr web UI and API.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Protects the UI and API. Strongly recommended: set a long random value.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored Sonarr/Radarr/Plex/Seerr API keys. If empty, one is generated in /data/secret.key.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: trace, debug, info, warn or error.
